profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Principal Consultant
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned full-stack developer and systems administrator with over 10 years of professional experience in end-to-end software development, cloud infrastructure, and identity management. I approach every project with a design-forward mindset, building scalable, maintainable solutions across the full software development life cycle (SDLC).
I excel at managing cloud environments, user provisioning, and delivering complex, concurrent projects in fast-paced settings. Recently, my focus has been bridging the gap between legacy systems and modern cloud architectures—collaborating directly with AI teams to refactor and future-proof foundational enterprise software.

Key Proficiencies
* Infrastructure & Identity: Managing Azure VMs/users, Microsoft Entra, and Active Directory.
* FileMaker Platform Expert: Cross-platform deployments utilizing FileMaker Server on Ubuntu Linux, Client, WebDirect, and Go.
* Core Development: Full life-cycle engineering, cloud architecture, and legacy modernization with AI teams.
* Languages & Frameworks: C++, JavaScript, Java, T-SQL, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, jQuery, Highcharts.js, Bootstrap.
* ERP/CRM & Cloud: Viewpoint Vista ERP, Infor CloudSuite Industrial ERP, MS SharePoint, APIs, GitLab.
* Database & Tools: MS SQL Server, SSRS, Postman, MS Visual Studio.
* OS: Ubuntu Linux, macOS, Windows/Microsoft Server.

Certifications
* AI Fundamentals II: Using LLMs in Claris FileMaker – Associate
* App Developer for Claris FileMaker Pro – Expert
* Claris FileMaker Server Administrator – Expert
* AGS Advanced Generative AI: Building LLM Applications
* AGS Advanced Generative AI: Models and Architectures
* AGS Applied Generative AI Specialization

I am passionate about delivering user-centered applications and expanding my skillset in cloud operations, identity security, and generative AI. I also specialize in producing comprehensive technical documentation, including work instructions, user manuals, and system analysis materials.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
We are a service-oriented, commercial floor covering contractor. The foundation of our business is built on providing best-in-class products and flawless installations, on time, every time, with exceptional service.

My responsibilities are:

Process Optimization & System Modernization
* Analyze, streamline, and modernize current corporate workflows, databases, and core software applications.
* Partner with specialized AI teams to refactor and upgrade legacy software applications, introducing modern features and automation.

Full-Stack Development & ERP Management
* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable FileMaker-based solutions.
* Manage and support Viewpoint Vista ERP.
* Develop complex T-SQL stored procedures, database views, and custom SSRS reports within Microsoft SQL Server.
* Design and refine modern software interfaces that allow users to intuitively create, store, search, and edit business-critical data.

Cloud Infrastructure, Identity & Linux Administration
* Manage Virtual Machines and user resources within Microsoft Azure.
* Deploy and maintain cross-platform database environments by provisioning FileMaker Server on Ubuntu Linux.
* Administer identity governance, access control, and secure user directories using Microsoft Entra and Active Directory.
* Use web-based APIs to seamlessly integrate custom database solutions with external cloud services.
* Oversee and architect the structure of the company's cloud-based Microsoft SharePoint repositories.

Business Analysis & Technical Enablement
* Translate complex business requirements into tangible, production-ready technical architecture.
* Compose comprehensive documentation including technical manuals, step-by-step work instructions, and clear visual aids.
* Instruct, train, and support corporate personnel on utilizing newly deployed software solutions.
* Provide advanced technical assistance to users for troubleshooting miscellaneous, high-priority IT and infrastructure issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Design and implement version control solutions, ensuring thorough documentation.
* Develop, deploy, and maintain robust FileMaker applications, adhering to best practices.
* Oversee the translation of business needs into actionable requirements, managing their implementation.
* Provide comprehensive training to personnel on application usage and best practices.
* Create user manuals, procedural documents, and visual aids to support efficient utilization of applications.
* Administer hosted databases through FileMaker Server, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Formulate algorithms and SQL queries for advanced data analysis.
* Craft interactive data visualizations, leveraging libraries such as Data-Driven Documents (D3.js),  jQuery, Highcharts, and Bootstrap.
* Utilize RESTful web APIs to integrate disparate systems and streamline workflows.
* Develop custom functions utilizing languages such as AppleScript, PowerShell, and C#.
* Tailor INFOR CloudSuite Industrial ERP source code to meet specific business requirements.
* Continuously assess and optimize operational processes to adapt to evolving business landscapes.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: 25 Park Way, Upper Saddle River, NJ · On-site
positions.description:
Founded in 1955 by aerospace machinist William “Willie” Strohmeyer, Triangle quickly established itself as the go-to supplier of specialized machinery parts. After decades of growth, along with the addition of Willie’s son Neal Strohmeyer to the team in 1971, Triangle began to invest in cutting-edge technologies to lead them into a new era of manufacturing. 

Almost 70 years after its founding, Triangle is now a 250-person business occupying 107,000 square feet in Upper Saddle River, NJ — far from its humble origins in a 2000 square-foot garage. Despite the growth, the family spirit remains at the heart of what happens at Triangle, because — in Willie Strohmeyer’s own words —

“At the end of the day, it’s the people that matter most.”

Responsibilities:

* Develop/document revision control software solutions.
* Design, develop, implement, and maintain intuitive FileMaker applications.
* Manage and implement business requirements.
* Instruct personnel on how to use applications.
* Compose user manuals, work instructions, and visual aids.
* Manage hosted databases using FileMaker Server.
* Develop algorithms and SQL statements for data analysis.
* Design and code interactive charts that represent statistical information using Data-Driven Documents open source library (d3js.org), and jquery/highchart js libraries.
* Use Web based APIs to interconnect different solutions.
* Develop custom functions using MS VBScript, Applescript, powershell.
* Customize INFOR CloudSuite Industrial ERP source code to implement business requirements.
* Constantly analyze/streamline current processes to accommodate changing environments.

positions.description:
Founded in 1943 by brothers Tom and Leif Meberg, Consolidated Carpet quickly built a reputation for quality floor covering installations. We are one of the nation's largest and most recognized full-service floor covering contractors, we serve our clients from planning and specification through installation and maintenance. Our prestigious clients include Fortune 500 corporations, professional service firms, luxury hotel properties, institutional properties, real estate owners, and general contractors.

My responsibilities are:

* Analyze and streamline current processes and systems.
* Design, develop, implement, and maintain FileMaker based solutions.
* Manage and implement business requirements.
* Design and/or update new/current software interfaces which enable users to create, store, search, and edit data in the most intuitive manner.
* Instruct personnel on how to use newly designed solutions.
* Compose user manuals, work instructions, and visual aids.
* Manage hosted databases using FileMaker Server Software.
* Manage users through Active Directory and Microsoft SQL Server.
* Use Web based APIs to link FileMaker solutions to Cosential (Cloud CRM) and Sharepoint.
* Develop stored procedures and views.
* Design SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports.
* Manage Vistas’ Viewpoint ERP and Field Manager applications.
* Manage the company's Microsoft Sharepoint cloud repository.
* Assist users on troubleshooting miscellaneous IT issues.

projects.title: FileMaker - Watermarking PDF files in Windows
projects.description:
This solution “draws” a text watermark on a PDF file. With the help of a dynamically created VBscript, the application is able to programmatically edit a PDF file and write a text watermark on a specified section of the PDF document.  The application only works in the Windows Operating System and on open (non-secure) PDF files.

There are input fields and list boxes used to set the watermark text, font, size, color, opacity, degrees to turn, vertical, and horizontal alignments. Error handling routines are set on the VBscript and FileMaker code.

projects.title: FileMaker - Record Log
projects.description:
This solution captures a record's data change into a log.  The log stores the field names, along with the date and time changed, the user who made the change, and what the data was before and after the change.

The log text is wrapped within html tags and presented in a web viewer. I use the jquery library to implement search functionality. This module works seamlessly in Windows and Mac. To refresh the log data, a callback event that uses FileMaker’s fmp protocol is set.

This project is completely modular. All you have to do is copy one layout object, script, and custom function into your solution to make it work.
